description: This file contains the code-behind for the UserProfile web page in an online examination system. It manages user profile display by fetching user data from a SQL Server database and handles navigation between pages and user session management.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile.aspx page, handling page load events and button click events for navigation and session management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Loads user data from database if session exists; otherwise redirects to login page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Method stub intended for profile button click, currently commented out.

methods.name: NameTB_TextChanged
methods.description: Event handler for name text box change event; currently does nothing.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the taken courses page.
